vehicles: Motor vehicles over 3.5 t technically permissible maximum mass: R2 two axles, R3 three, R4 more than three
tolled_roads: The DARS motorway and expressway network, 129 toll sections; a section is charged when the route passes both of its ends. Not included: the 1.4 km Serminska vpadnica to the port of Koper, and the Karavanke tunnel, which is tolled separately at the tunnel.

sections.tariff_groups: Toll classes R2 (2 axles), R3 (3), R4 (more than 3); columns EURO 0-III, IV, V, EEV, VI with CO2 class 1, then EURO VI with CO2 classes 2-5. EEV is priced as EURO V here.
